name: Gas Dynamics
description: Introduction, propagation of infinitesimal waves: speed of sound, mach number, mach cone, review of thermodynamics and von Karman's rules of supersonic flow; formulating integral and differential laws for compressible flows; adiabatic and isentropic flow relations; one-dimensional compressible flow and normal shocks; second law analysis of shocks and Hugoniot relation, propagating normal shocks, shock tube fundamentals and reflection of normal shockwaves; the critical area ration and quasi-1d isentropic flows with rocket propulsion applications; operating characteristics of convergent-divergent nozzles; flow with friction (Fanno flow) and flow with heat transfer (Rayleigh flow); introduction to shadowgraphy and schlieren; oblique shocks and Prandtl-Meyer expansion fans; shock polar, reflection and interaction of shocks, basic shock expansion theory; special topics set I (advanced gas dynamics); special topics set II including gas dynamics applications.
